name: Lower-third — cinematic with anamorphic flare
description: Broadcast-grade lower-third using the lower-third family's `cinematic` variant per ADR-0020. The family's shaderPass gates the anamorphic horizontal flare (6:1 stretched ellipse with chromatic offset, sweeps across the overlay rect during entrance window 0.02 → 0.16) to the cinematic variant via a flareEnabled uniform; resting state carries a constant warm rim glow at the lower-left implying an off-frame key light.
